easy_fields.name: PASTIS (Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme-Series)
easy_fields.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Garnot, Loic Landrieu
easy_fields.description: PASTIS is the first open-access Satellite Image Time Series (SITS) dataset with panoptic annotations, designed for training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models. It comprises 2,433 sequences of multi-spectral images (10 channels, 128x128 pixels) collected between September 2018 and November 2019 from four diverse regions of France, covering over 4000 km². Each pixel is annotated with a semantic label for 18 crop types and a unique instance label for agricultural parcels.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper extensively details the data collection, stating it uses Sentinel-2 multi-spectral images from September 2018 to November 2019 across four regions of France, and discusses irregular temporal sampling due to cloud cover filtering.

G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper describes the annotation source (French Land Parcel Identification System), the 18 crop types plus background, the number of individualized parcels (124,422), and the accuracy of crop annotations via in situ control (over 98%).

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper discusses the economic and environmental implications of the task, the dataset's class imbalance, the intended use for panoptic segmentation, and the handling of out-of-scope parcels with a 'void label'.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper mentions automatic filtering of cloudy acquisitions, re-sampling of Sentinel-2 bands, cropping of parcel extents, and a padding strategy for variable sequence lengths during training.
